name: SoCalGas North-South Project
researcher_notes: Intrastate line (CPUC, docket A.13-12-013), so no FERC filing. CPUC press release says the commission denied SoCalGas's request to build the North-South Pipeline Project between Adelanto and the Moreno Pressure Limiting Station, plus a partial rebuild of the Adelanto Compressor Station. World Pipelines (July 2016) says 65 miles, 36 inch, about $621.3 million, denied 5-0 for lack of need. EIA August 2026 release, sheet Historical Projects, Excel row 1162, lists North-South Project, Southern California Gas Co, New Pipeline, Denied, 621 million dollars, 63 miles, 300 MMcf/d; EIA does not state diameter. Length differs between sources (65 vs 63 mi); staged 65 mi from World Pipelines, EIA 63 noted. Cost staged from World Pipelines in full dollars. Capacity 300 MMcf/d from EIA only. Not a match to any roster row: P6233 SoCalGas Pipeline is an operating system, unrelated. Threshold: sponsor yes, endpoints yes, concrete step yes (application filed Dec 2013 and decided), length over 25 km yes. Status cancelled because the regulator denied it. Owner spelling follows EIA; entity_style gave a medium-confidence match, not an exact gazetteer hit, so the ownership team should confirm. ProposalYear 2013 inferred from the A.13-12-013 docket number. No route found; no official GIS located. Tier medium: two sources, but EIA is one origin and the press story is trade press.
